captions: Saima asks for a second pair of eyes whenever a result will affect the public table. Mine are slow eyes, which is useful when everyone else is excited.
Read Measured, Repeated, and Remainder before touching the conductors. The first reading tells us what the instrument claims. We can then ask whether the claim survives the same test twice.
I am not trying to keep wonder out of the room. I am trying to make sure a family can tell whether the light promised to them is actually coming.

choices.text: How do you record an unknown?

greeting.repeatText: Read each conductor before changing it. A household should be able to check the light we promise.

loads.text: Measured needs 1 unit, Repeated needs 2, Remainder needs 3. Inspect each channel, then set its measured load. No pulse order is required.

unknown.text: A claim gets a witness and conditions before it gets a cause. A second reading can disagree with the first.

four-accounts.text: I checked each account against its own conditions. Their differences survived the check. The final device is ready; Nemi may name an order, and I will tell you whether it truly repeats.

completed.text: The named order repeats. I have entered that result separately from the meaning Nemi gives it.
